einzeiler: NASCAR champion Kurt Busch remembers his brother Kyle and shares his sudden grief.
kurzfassung: NASCAR champion Kurt Busch reflects on the life and legacy of his younger brother, Kyle Busch, who passed away suddenly from sepsis following pneumonia. Kurt discusses their intense sibling rivalry, their shared progression into professional racing, and the deep unspoken bond they shared on the track. He also opens up about how he, his family, and the racing community are navigating their profound loss.
stichpunkte: Kyle Busch died on May 21st, 2026, at age 41 from severe pneumonia that rapidly progressed to sepsis.
Growing up in Las Vegas, both brothers were introduced to cars and racing by their father, Tom.
Kurt and Kyle became fierce competitors in NASCAR, maintaining a strong sibling rivalry while also supporting each other's careers.
In 2015, Kyle narrowly beat Kurt in a memorable one-two finish at Sonoma shortly after recovering from a severe leg and foot crash.
Kurt was recently inducted into the NASCAR Hall of Fame in January, with Kyle giving his induction speech.
Kyle's sudden illness developed rapidly over a 12-hour period after he fell ill during a simulator session.
Kurt shares that returning to the racetrack and talking about his brother helps him process his grief, though the loss still feels surreal.
beschreibung:
NASCAR champions and brothers Kurt and Kyle Busch spent decades racing each other before Kyle’s sudden death in May at 41. Kurt talks with Anderson Cooper about their years of “sibling rivalry,” the “brotherhood” they shared on the racetrack and where he feels Kyle’s presence the most. For more of “All There Is with Anderson Cooper” visit cnn.com/allthereis.
